Name: New Shirts and 2 new Skirts
Author: alicedafox
Description:
[b]Hey Stardew-Lovers![img]http://community.playstarbound.com/styles/default/xenforo/clear.png[/img]

I want to share some of my shirts and two skirts with you.

Read [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/new-shirts-2-new-skirts-for-get-dressed.132686/]this[/url] thread for more information! 



[b]Installation instructions for the shirts
[/b]
[list]
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract the archive
[*]Go to Stardew Valley/Content/Characters/Farmer
[*]Replace the shirts.xnb file with the provided
[*][b]Remember to make a backup of your files![/b]
[/list]




[b]You need Smapi and get dressed to use the skirts!
[/b]
Download SMAPI [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-stardew-modding-api.108375/]Here[/url]
Download Get dressed [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-get-dressed-updated-for-1-1.113731/]Here[/url] [i](Currently Outdated)[/i]

[b]I took the updated version of get dressed from this awesome dude → [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/how-to-fix-mods-broken-in-stardew-valley-1-2.132096/]Pathoschild[/url] and edited it in there.[/b]


[b]Installation instructions: [/b]If you havent downloaded the updated get dressed :
[list]
[*]Download the file ''Get Dressed-Skirts''
[*]Extract the archive
[*]Go where you installed SMAPI
[*]Place the Get dressed folder in your Mod folder
[/list]


[b]Installation instructions: [/b]If you already updated your get dressed or you want to mix the skirts for example.
[list]
[*]Download the file ''female_bottoms''
[*]Go where you installed SMAPI
[*]Replace the female_bottoms with the downloaded one (In your Mods/Get dressed folder)
[*]Open the config.json (for example with Notepad++)
[*]Change "FemaleBottomsTypes": [b]12,[/b] to "FemaleBottomsTypes": [b]14,[/b]
[/list]
[b]You need to do this step if you install it your own - otherwise you dont have the original skirts from get dressed! (The skirts will replace 2 of them if you dont change it!)

[/b]


[/b]
[b]CREDITS:[/b]
Shirts and Skirts are all made by me!
Except: Shirt Nr. 156 (made by  [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/female-lowcut-shirts-mini-skirt.110494/]RuneNL[/url] ) - I just changed it a bit.
